请假审批流程定义。平台只声明引用，内容随快照一起版本化；Flowable 部署时按 assetId+version 取二进制

constraints: userTask 的 id 必须与 Flow.taskForms[].taskKey 一一对应，L3 校验会解析 XML 比对

inline.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!--
  请假审批流程定义。
  平台约定（三条硬约束，L3 校验会逐条检查）：
  1. userTask 的 id 必须与 Flow.taskForms[].taskKey 完全一致；
  2. 平台不把办理人解析逻辑写进 BPMN —— 部署时由 LcpTaskListener 依据 Flow.taskForms[].assignee
     (AssigneeSpec) 结合组织模型解析，因此 BPMN 内不出现 assignee / candidateGroups 表达式；
     这样同一份流程定义在校（部门-院系）与公司（部门-事业部）两套组织模型下都可复用。
  3. 网关条件以平台的 JSON 表达式树为源真相，存放在 flowable:field name="lcpExprSource" 中；
     conditionExpression 内的 JUEL 是 BpmnConditionCompiler 生成的编译产物，回读时以 lcpExprSource 为准。
-->
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
             xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
             xmlns:flowable="http://flowable.org/bpmn"
             xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
             targetNamespace="http://lcp.dev/bpmn/leave"
             typeLanguage="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">

  <process id="leave_approval" name="请假审批" isExecutable="true">
    <documentation>提交 → 部门负责人 → （大于等于 3 工作日 或 需佐证）院级审批 → 结束；超 15 个工作日年假直接院级。</documentation>

    <extensionElements>
      <flowable:executionListener event="start" delegateExpression="${lcpProcessStartListener}"/>
      <flowable:executionListener event="end" expression="${lcpProcessEndListener}"/>
    </extensionElements>

    <startEvent id="startLeave" name="发起请假" flowable:formKey="page_leave_form"/>

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_start_to_apply" sourceRef="startLeave" targetRef="applySubmit"/>

    <userTask id="applySubmit" name="申请人提交" flowable:formKey="page_leave_form">
      <documentation>由 leave_submit 动作启动流程后自动完成；仅在「退回修改」后重新出现，供申请人补充材料。</documentation>
      <extensionElements>
        <flowable:taskListener event="create" delegateExpression="${lcpTaskListener}"/>
        <flowable:taskListener event="complete" delegateExpression="${lcpTaskListener}"/>
      </extensionElements>
    </userTask>

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_apply_to_leader" sourceRef="applySubmit" targetRef="deptLeaderApprove"/>

    <userTask id="deptLeaderApprove" name="部门负责人审批" flowable:formKey="page_leave_approval">
      <documentation>部门负责人可核减 days（inout 变量），核减后继续流转。</documentation>
      <extensionElements>
        <flowable:taskListener event="create" delegateExpression="${lcpTaskListener}"/>
        <flowable:taskListener event="complete" delegateExpression="${lcpTaskListener}"/>
        <flowable:taskListener event="timeout" delegateExpression="${lcpSlaListener}"/>
      </extensionElements>
    </userTask>

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_leader_to_gw" sourceRef="deptLeaderApprove" targetRef="gwNeedSchool"/>

    <exclusiveGateway id="gwNeedSchool" name="是否需要院级审批" default="flow_gw_to_end"/>

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_need_school" name="需院级" sourceRef="gwNeedSchool" targetRef="schoolApprove">
      <extensionElements>
        <flowable:field name="lcpExprSource">
          <flowable:string>{"$fn":"or","$args":[{"$fn":"eq","$args":[{"$ref":"$process.variables.needProof"},{"$lit":true}]},{"$fn":"gte","$args":[{"$ref":"$process.variables.days"},{"$lit":3}]},{"$fn":"and","$args":[{"$fn":"eq","$args":[{"$ref":"$process.variables.leaveType"},{"$lit":"annual"}]},{"$fn":"gt","$args":[{"$ref":"$process.variables.days"},{"$lit":15}]}]}]}</flowable:string></flowable:field>
      </extensionElements>
      <conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[${needProof == true || days >= 3 || (leaveType == 'annual' && days > 15)}]]></conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_gw_to_end" name="直接结束" sourceRef="gwNeedSchool" targetRef="endLeave"/>

    <userTask id="schoolApprove" name="院级审批" flowable:formKey="page_leave_approval">
      <extensionElements>
        <flowable:taskListener event="create" delegateExpression="${lcpTaskListener}"/>
        <flowable:taskListener event="complete" delegateExpression="${lcpTaskListener}"/>
        <flowable:taskListener event="timeout" delegateExpression="${lcpSlaListener}"/>
      </extensionElements>
    </userTask>

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_school_to_end" sourceRef="schoolApprove" targetRef="endLeave"/>

    <endEvent id="endLeave" name="结束">
      <extensionElements>
        <flowable:executionListener event="end" delegateExpression="${lcpProcessEndListener}"/>
      </extensionElements>
    </endEvent>
  </process>
</definitions>
